question: Should OpenClaw establish safetyDiagnostics.emit and manifest safetyEventTypes as a supported public plugin contract in this release, or should the first landing remain core-only until an owner approves the extension design?
rationale: This choice defines a long-lived plugin manifest and SDK surface across trust, diagnostics, and operator observability; code review cannot safely infer the desired public contract.

options.title: Approve a narrow public contract
options.body: Accept the host-bound plugin emitter and manifest declaration after an owner explicitly confirms the capability, lifecycle, compatibility promise, and documentation boundary.

options.title: Land core-only diagnostics first
options.body: Remove the new public plugin API and manifest field from this PR, retain only approved core emitters and exporters, and design the plugin contract separately.

options.title: Pause the feature series
options.body: Keep the branch unmerged until a diagnostics and plugin-SDK owner sponsors the complete taxonomy and public operator surface.

recommendation.title: Land core-only diagnostics first
recommendation.body: Remove the new public plugin API and manifest field from this PR, retain only approved core emitters and exporters, and design the plugin contract separately.

likelyOwner.reason: skoya is the recent contributor across the proposed taxonomy and can incorporate the selected scope, while an unidentified current-main SDK owner should co-decide the public contract.
